Heard learned counsel for the applicant, learned AGA and perused the record.
No one appears for the opposite party no.2 despite notice.
2. The accused-applicant seeks bail in Case Crime No.244 of 2024 under sections 363, 366, 376-D IPC and section 5G/6 POCSO Act, P.S. Sandhana, District Sitapur.

3. The FIR was lodged as a missing person report alleging that the daughter of the informant aged Jeewan Lal vs State Of U.P. Thru. Prin. Secy. Home ... on 12 September, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/171424995/
1 about 13 years was missing and was enticed by two accused including the applicant.

entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: It was also stated that she had taken substantial money and jewellery with her.

In the statement under section 161 Cr.P.C., the victim did not support the prosecution story and stated that she had gone out of her free will and she also stated that the applicant was already married and nothing wrong was done to her

, however, the statement was changed in the statement under section 164 Cr.P.C. although in the said statement also, she admitted that she had taken substantial money and jewellery with her from home.
The victim refused to undergo medical examination.
The tentative age of the victim is around 17 years and 10 months.

4. Considering the victim refusing to undergo medical examination and there being no allegation of rape in the statement under section 161 Cr.P.C., the applicant who is in custody since 03.07.2024 and has no criminal history is entitled for the bail.
Thus the bail application is allowed.

5. Let the applicant Jeewan Lal be released on bail in aforesaid first information report number subject to his furnishing a personal bond and two reliable sureties of Rs.20,000/- (Twenty Thousand) each of the like amount to the satisfaction of the court concerned with the following conditions:
(a) The applicant shall execute a bond to undertake to attend the hearings;
(b) The applicant shall not commit any offence similar to the offence of which he is accused or suspected of the commission; and (c) The applicant shall not directly or indirectly make any inducement, threat or promise to any person acquainted with the facts of the case so as to dissuade him from disclosing such facts to the Court or to any police officer or tamper with the evidence.
Order Date :- 12.9.2024 VNP/-
